meta.name: Dayaa
meta.description:
A reserved freezer van driver gets pushed into a chaotic situation wants to escape to safety, an upright journalist chases the truth, a husband is on the hunt for his wife, a cop wants to make progress in his investigation, a woman is in search of her identity and a culprit is after power.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: The Blood Moon
videos.overview: A woman's body in his freezer van and an unusual task from his boss lands Dayaa in a pickle. Should he heed his fisherman friend Prabha's advice?

videos.title: The Grave
videos.overview: Kaushik, the husband of popular journalist Kavitha Naidu, lodges a police complaint when she goes missing. On receiving a threatening call, Dayaa panics and seeks Prabha's help.

videos.title: Middle of Nowhere
videos.overview: Dayaa and Prabha see an opportunity to get rid of their problem when they come across an old woman's corpse. However, later, their van goes missing.

videos.title: Who Are You?
videos.overview: With the cops chasing them, Dayaa and his friends find themselves in grave danger. While Shabana tries to set things right, IPS Harischandra reveals a shocking truth.

videos.title: The Twist
videos.overview: Dayaa and Prabha get into trouble while trying to retrieve the buried corpse. As they attempt to escape, a scary surprise awaits them.

videos.title: The Evidence
videos.overview: In her interview with Kavitha, Swecha reveals why she was raped. In the present, Dayaa brings in help to retrieve the pen drive from Kavitha.

videos.title: The Sorry
videos.overview: Dayaa goes in search of Swecha but gets waylaid by Prabha's call for help. While Kabir finds Shabana, Harry meets Parashurama Raju with a warning.

videos.title: The Saga
videos.overview: Dayaa's rage is unleashed. As Kavitha's death gives Kaushik a new purpose, Parashurama Raju gets an unpleasant surprise.
